name: @manavkhadka0/nepal-address
description: A universal npm package for Nepal's administrative data (provinces, districts, municipalities) with TypeScript support, search capabilities, and validation utilities

scripts.build: npm run build:clean && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:esm
scripts.build:esm: tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json --outDir dist-temp && mv dist-temp/index.js dist/index.mjs 2>/dev/null || cp dist-temp/index.js dist/index.mjs && rm -rf dist-temp

author: manavkhadka0
